scope: Targeted originality screen; not systematic review

primary_sources.title: Enhanced Inferencing: Estimation of a Workload Dependent Performance Model
primary_sources.access: Full primary text, selected methods; prior assessment retained
primary_sources.overlap: Load-dependent demand/overhead; joint utilization and mean-response inference
primary_sources.limitation: Not reproduced; not refuted by CPU-only quadratic benchmark

primary_sources.title: Estimate Load-dependent Service Demand for Modern CPU
primary_sources.access: Primary HTML reviewed in retained assessment; equation-image limits
primary_sources.overlap: Polynomial demand in utilization and constrained response-aware inference
primary_sources.limitation: Exact image coefficients unresolved; no faithful fit

primary_sources.title: SARDE: A Framework for Continuous and Self-Adaptive Resource Demand Estimation
primary_sources.access: Full author preprint, selected methods and evaluation
primary_sources.overlap: Estimator/window tuning and ensemble selection; utilization and mean-response validation
primary_sources.limitation: Different evaluated loss is not proof of new selection method; no code reproduction

primary_sources.title: A Non-stationary Service Curve Model for Performance Analysis of Transient Phases
primary_sources.access: Full author preprint, model and measurement methods
primary_sources.overlap: Transient service curves, delay/backlog bounds and minimal probes with accuracy assessment
primary_sources.limitation: Need justified treatment of load dependence/loss; generic timescale/probing route overlaps

primary_sources.title: Robust queueing theory: an initial study using imprecise probabilities
primary_sources.access: Primary author PDF, abstract/introduction and model description
primary_sources.sections: Abstract, introduction, finite-capacity discrete-time queue model
primary_sources.overlap: Performance bounds with imprecise arrival/departure probabilities
primary_sources.limitation: Not a reproduced exact fixed-trace deadline-fraction solver

primary_sources.title: Error Bounds for Perturbing Nonexponential Queues
primary_sources.access: Author PDF available; abstract/introduction screened; publisher abstract verified
primary_sources.sections: Abstract/introduction; GI/G/1/N, M/G/c/N and GI/M/c/N scope
primary_sources.limitation: No detailed theorem reproduction; absence of a deadline keyword is not absence of applicability

primary_sources.title: High-Level Modelling, Analysis, and Verification on FPGA-Based Hardware Design
primary_sources.access: Full four-page conference paper, selected sections
primary_sources.sections: Sections 3–4; timed lossy/delayed FIFO and parametric cases
primary_sources.overlap: Queue size, timing and overflow analysis using Uppaal/TReX
primary_sources.limitation: Must compare equivalent formulation; cannot claim first uncertain finite-buffer analysis

primary_sources.title: A unified formalism for monoprocessor schedulability analysis under uncertainty
primary_sources.sections: Sections 3–5; scheduler/queue encoding and IMITATOR synthesis
primary_sources.overlap: Uncertain timing and robust schedulability via parametric automata
primary_sources.limitation: Miss-count observer could be straightforward extension; no artifact benchmark

primary_sources.title: Uncertainty-Aware Resource Allocation for Multi-Path Programs with In-Kernel Predictions
primary_sources.access: Indexed primary abstract/introduction; repeated live HTML/PDF timeout
primary_sources.sections: Abstract/introduction only relied on in this decision
primary_sources.overlap: Prediction uncertainty, weighted conformal prediction, deadline-constrained allocation
primary_sources.limitation: Cannot claim full algorithm audit or FIFO competitor; implementation not reproduced

primary_sources.title: CPU Autoscaling With a Kernel of Truth
primary_sources.access: Full author paper, selected method and discussion
primary_sources.sections: Sections 3–4; Passing Application SLOs Into the Kernel
primary_sources.overlap: Runtime/idle-informed quota and period control; SLO future-work statement
primary_sources.limitation: Future work is local to paper, not a global novelty certificate

primary_sources.title: Autothrottle: A Practical Bi-Level Approach to Resource Management for SLO-Targeted Microservices
primary_sources.overlap: Application SLO control and per-service throttle target CPU allocation
primary_sources.limitation: Generic SLO-aware CPU management already covered; no implementation comparison

primary_sources.title: Periodic resource model for compositional real-time guarantees
primary_sources.access: Primary institutional abstract; attempted full-text access failed
primary_sources.overlap: Periodic allocation resource model and exact EDF/RM schedulability conditions
primary_sources.limitation: Do not invent full source equations; not a CFS ceiling guarantee

primary_sources.title: Strong Temporal Isolation Among Containers in OpenStack for NFV Services
primary_sources.overlap: Guaranteed reservation and isolated demand-based response approximations
primary_sources.limitation: Different resource guarantee; cannot directly substitute fractional CFS quota

decision: Hold experimental gate; bounded offline feasibility only
candidate: Efficient sound finite-trace all-offer deadline bounds across continuous service uncertainty with tail-drop rejection

nonstationary service curves and minimal probing
